title: Healing Simon’s mother-in-law
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 1 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child retells the healing of Simon's mother-in-law (Luke 4:38-39) and says she showed thanks by serving.

floor.question: What do you say when someone helps you?

board.do: Draw a woman in bed with a fever.

board.say: What did she do after Jesus healed her?

board.do: Wait for the child to say she served them.

misconceptions.ask: What was wrong with Simon's mother-in-law?
misconceptions.repair: Touch a forehead: hot means fever.

misconceptions.ask: What did she do after she was healed?
misconceptions.repair: Act out getting up and serving food.
Explain: the mother of Simon's wife.
